name: Maximum Omega Ratio Portfolio
description: Maximizes the Omega ratio (Keating & Shadwick, 2002) — probability-weighted gains over losses relative to a threshold return — using the full return distribution rather than just mean/variance. Long-only, weights sum to 1, SLSQP optimizer over the daily return scenario matrix. A construction objective distinct from minimum-variance, minimum-CVaR and minimum-semivariance.
